scope: Temporary instrumentation artifact only; never installed in a working user device or copied to production source. Remove and rebuild after acceptance.
channel: Documents/NovalistAudit/command.json -> response.json; ready.json written after native bridge readiness
protocol: One JSON command at a time: {"id":"unique synthetic ID","op":"eval","script":"JSON.stringify({ready:document.readyState})"}. Write to a temporary file and rename atomically. Poll response.json until id matches. Evaluations execute on MainThread in actual WKWebView; asynchronous JS should store synthetic results on window and be polled separately.
fault_deadlines: DeliverCallbackAsync retains original 15-second WaitAsync and bridge failure retains 2-second notification deadline. Poll thread stays responsive.
process_association: state returns private debug-only _webProcessIdentifier when supported; no process is terminated by the harness.
acceptance: Actual native WKWebView DOM evaluation succeeded: document.readyState complete, Novalist title, welcome UI buttons, window.novalist object. No M04/R13/R14 acceptance case claimed complete.
launch_preparation: Unsigned app and manual deep ad-hoc signing both died before managed code with CODESIGNING Invalid Page. Rebuilt with EnableCodeSigning=true and CodesignKey=- using MSBuild; codesign verification and dedicated simulator launch then succeeded.
